title: Trajectory 007: Normalize and reconcile all July 27 agent work
description: Inventory every local agent session modified on 2026-07-27 across CT, CA, direct Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Pi, Agy, and the remaining supported stores; repair Trajectory's Agy discovery and normalization against the installed Antigravity 1.1.7 store; and produce a provenance-backed HomeBase/Bridge/Orbit decision reconciliation. Source transcripts are evidence; this ticket and its reconciliation report do not become policy authority.

official_upstream: google-antigravity/antigravity-cli CHANGELOG: version 1.0.4 declares SQLite .db conversations as the CLI conversation format
Installed agy 1.1.7 exposes --conversation and --continue but no transcript export or local-store schema command
capability_inventory.githits_prior_art: GitHits 0.6.4 searches of google-antigravity/antigravity-cli for transcript, SQLite conversation steps, trajectory_meta, and step_payload returned no indexed implementation contract
installed_runtime: ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/conversations/<conversation-id>.db contains trajectory/step blobs rather than a conventional role/content message table
~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/brain/<conversation-id>/.system_generated/logs/transcript.jsonl is the readable generated transcript for that conversation
cursor_inventory: Cursor 3.13.21 exposes agent resume/list and stream-json output, but no local transcript export command
Official Cursor documentation says chat history is local and chats can be exported; the installed agent store is ~/.cursor/chats/<workspace-hash>/<chat-id>/store.db
GitHits prior art maps the installed store to a blobs table, but no Cursor session was modified on 2026-07-27, so the existing Cursor adapter and TODO lister are not changed by this ticket
capability_inventory.adoption_decision: List conversation .db files as source identities, resolve their matching generated transcript.jsonl, and normalize the log's typed steps. Do not decode undocumented SQLite protobuf blobs.

acceptance: listTrajectories(source=agy) discovers local .db conversations newest first and returns the readable transcript path when present
Sanitized Agy golden fixtures normalize user, assistant, reasoning, tool-call, and tool-result records with stable identities
Every supported local source is probed for 2026-07-27; every readable active transcript is normalized or has an explicit failure record
The reconciliation report cites source, session ID, canonical record identity, and distinguishes captain decisions from agent claims and observed implementation
Typecheck, unit tests, build, and live normalization proof commands pass
